description: Get the receipt for one of your workspace's priced calls, by its usage event id (the id list_usage_events returns and report_outcome takes): what was priced, by which function and agent, when, the amount, how it was paid, and the outcome if one was reported. search_tools gives its full definition.

usage_event_id.description: The priced call's usage event id, as list_usage_events returns it.

name: get_receipt

message.description: A short sentence about the result that an agent can show its person.
